extracted.intended_audience: public relations consultancies, PR trade associations, and clients seeking PR agencies
extracted.subtask_description: Information and standards governing ICCO membership and the Agency Finder: what membership implies about an agency’s ethical, quality, and professional practices, and how clients can identify member agencies. Useful for agencies considering membership and clients vetting consultancies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to follow highest ethical and business standards
rubrics_metrics.description: "All agencies are members of their National PR and Communications Associations and as such are obliged to follow highest ethical and business standards.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being listed via ICCO/Agency Finder signals that an agency is expected to adhere to the ethical and business conduct required by its national association; clients can treat membership as an assurance of baseline professional behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to raise standards of quality
rubrics_metrics.description: "Members work together to raise standards of quality",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICCO membership entails collective activity aimed at improving quality across member consultancies; agencies are expected to participate in efforts to elevate sector-wide quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing ethical issues collaboratively
rubrics_metrics.description: "Members work together to ... address ethical issues",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A requirement/expectation that members engage in identifying, debating and resolving ethical challenges in PR practice; implies internal mechanisms or participation in ICCO-led ethical guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harmonisation of professional PR consultancy practice
rubrics_metrics.description: "Members work together to ... harmonise professional PR consultancy practice",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICCO promotes alignment of professional standards and practices across countries and associations; members should adopt or support harmonised professional norms and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Knowledge sharing among members
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership includes access to peer learning and knowledge exchange; agencies are expected to contribute to and benefit from shared resources, best-practice guidance and sector intelligence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participation in ICCO forums, meetings and events
rubrics_metrics.description: "ICCO provides a forum for senior management ... Members have an opportunity to meet in person twice a year at Board Meetings, at the bi-annual ICCO Global Summit, the Global PR Awards ceremony, and at any number of ICCO partner events.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Active engagement in governance and ICCO events is part of membership value/expectation — senior management attendance and participation in board/ summit/awards events supports networking, standards work and visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directory listing / Agency Finder registration as verification
rubrics_metrics.description: "Through the online directory, ICCO also acts as a matchmaker between consultancies in different countries... Clients: Browse PR and communications expertise across 70 countries, find specialists in the sector and location required. Agencies and consultants: Register now to join the PR industry’s database.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registration in the ICCO Agency Finder functions as a practical verification mechanism: listed agencies are members of national associations and thereby held to the stated ethical/business standards; clients can use the directory to find vetted specialists. Agencies not already members are directed to find out how to join.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of industry quality standard (CMS)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Many also have the industry quality standard CMS.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Possession of the CMS quality standard is an additional, explicit quality credential some member agencies hold; clients may use CMS certification as an extra indicator of agency quality and process maturity.
